reviewer.evidence:

Corrected the pie-chart label, true/false values, selected-overflow English, enabled/running status wording, artifact-panel label, and redacted-state wording; audited exact English-identical templates. This is not native-speaker certification. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.
